summary: Jigsaw Puzzles Epic: Jigsaw game with over 20,000 beautiful puzzles!
description:
Jigsaw Puzzles Epic features over 20,000 beautiful puzzles in a wide variety of categories, and has been enjoyed by millions of players for over 10 years. This premium jigsaw puzzle game is the best choice for lovers of jigsaw puzzles. Perfect puzzle game for adults, kids and seniors.

In Jigsaw Puzzles Epic you can travel all around the globe, see majestic landscapes, experience the seasons of the year and the wonders of the world, all from the peace and quiet of your own home. You can even create jigsaw puzzles from your own photos.

Our jigsaw puzzle game is like a real jig saw puzzle, but no missing pieces at all. With difficulty up to 625 pieces makes it a great free jigsaw puzzle game for adults and seniors. Enjoy daily new free puzzle games, so you will never run out of puzzle games to play. Our jigsaw game is addictive, easy to play with no gimmicks. Just pure play and fun playing puzzles.

Discover puzzle games in all kinds of categories like animals, flowers, countries, sceneries, food, landmarks, houses, cartoons, sports, wildlife and many more in our puzzle games. Solving puzzle games is a great way to relieve stress, go offline, and help your brain take a break.

Features:

• Over 20,000 beautiful, HD puzzles, in more than 400 different packs!
• Get new free jigsaw puzzles daily!
• New puzzle packs added frequently! Jigsaw Puzzles Epic has been updated regularly for over 10 years.
• Perfect jigsaw puzzle for adults, seniors and kids!
• 11 difficulty settings: Up to 625 jigsaw puzzle pieces!
• Play offline, no wifi Internet required!
• Create custom puzzles from your own photo collection.
• Every puzzle is unique: Different piece shapes every time! Play with rotated pieces for extra difficulty.
• Saves all puzzles in progress, so you can work on several games at the same time.
• Complete challenging goals!
• Zoom in and out, let's you see all the details and find the correct pieces.
• Crisp and beautiful HD puzzles that are clear and colorful.

People have enjoyed the classic puzzle games of jig saw for hundreds of years, and for good reason. Jigsaw Epic has easy to use controls and interface, focused on keeping things clear and simple, so that anyone can enjoy it. Since it's jigsaw puzzles for adults, you can play all jigsaw puzzle offline with no wifi as well.

Whether you're a casual brain puzzler or a seasoned jigsaw puzzle pro, Jigsaw Puzzles Epic offers free games and endless hours of relaxing and rewarding puzzle games fun for free.

We hope you enjoy our fun and free, jigsaw puzzle game! We've supported it for over 10 years and we will continue to support it!
